Workflows.title: Start a bank simulator session, confirm the dashboard is usable, and view the checking account activity as a read-only journey
Workflows.goal: The welcome page displays the Get Started button; The dashboard loads and shows the first-run welcome dialog; The welcome dialog closes; The dashboard displays the checking account activity card with an available balance; The browser navigates to the account activity page for the checking account; The account activity page shows the checking account selected and lists the transaction history including the account opening entry
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Open the public bank simulator home page — The welcome page displays the Get Started button
2. Start a new simulator session — The dashboard loads and shows the first-run welcome dialog
3. Dismiss the welcome dialog — The welcome dialog closes
4. Verify the dashboard is usable — The dashboard displays the checking account activity card with an available balance
5. Open the checking account activity from the dashboard — The browser navigates to the account activity page for the checking account
6. Verify the checking account transaction history — The account activity page shows the checking account selected and lists the transaction history including the account opening entry
